description: This file contains functions for bulk purging of field data, field definitions, and field storages in Drupal's Field API, including batch processing and cleanup operations.

methods.name: field_purge_batch
methods.description: Purges a batch of deleted field data, fields, and field storages based on batch size and optional storage ID.

methods.name: field_purge_field
methods.description: Purges a specific field definition and invokes related hooks.

methods.name: field_purge_field_storage
methods.description: Purges a field storage after ensuring no remaining fields exist, and invokes related hooks.
